description: Stereo tube distortion modelling a triode preamp stage, with a guitar-amp tone stack in front of the output and a choice of four circuits

params.text: Runs the signal through the tube stage when on; with it off the module is bypassed, and the switch crossfades between the two rather than stepping
Cuts or boosts the bottom of the tone stack, -11 to +11 with 0 at the centre
Cuts or boosts the middle of the tone stack, -11 to +11 with 0 at the centre
Cuts or boosts the top of the tone stack, -11 to +11 with 0 at the centre
Sets the gain driving the triode, from a linear part of the circuit at the left end to saturation at the right; the readout runs 0 to 11
Switches the tone stack in and out; the stack is not flat with BASS, MID and TREB centred, so switching it in changes the sound on its own
Sets how much of the distorted signal is in the output against the dry input, 0 to 100% wet
Adds a bass boost, to make up the bottom end that the distortion's added harmonics mask; it comes up off
Chooses which of four sets of circuit values the triode is modelled with, printed A, B, C and D, each giving a slightly different tone

inputs.text: Adds to the DIST knob, where 10V covers the whole of that knob's travel
Adds to the MIX knob, where 10V covers the whole of that knob's travel
Adds to the LEVEL knob, where 10V covers the whole of that knob's travel
The left audio input into the tube stage
The right audio input into the tube stage

outputs.text: The left output, carrying the dry signal and the tube stage in the proportion set by MIX
The right output, carrying the dry signal and the tube stage in the proportion set by MIX

notes: BASS, MID, TREB, TONE, X-BASS and MODEL have no input jack, so those six take no voltage control
the two channels are separate circuits and neither input is normalled to the other, so with nothing patched into IN II the OUT II jack stays at 0V
the circuit is modelled around a signal of ±1, and the module divides each input by 5 and multiplies each output by 5 to suit it, so ±5V is the level it expects
